integrity_controls.dimension: AI contribution, student ownership and submission eligibility

issues.baseline: The attached assessment did not retrieve artifacts; it did not report a verified slide failure.
issues.minimal_fix: Provide direct PDF, PPTX, README and manifest in a versioned review bundle, with commit/default-branch/non-LFS proof.
issues.acceptance: A reader can download actual binaries and inspect notes, hashes and the target commit without relying on a URL assertion.

issues.baseline: Slide 8 component prose and visual labels are not one-to-one; ingestion, audit and validated return are implicit.
issues.minimal_fix: Add component IDs and a registry; draw all relevant flows, with private-link/identity/TLS and external-processing qualifications.
issues.acceptance: Each registry ID exists in the diagram with matching label; ingestion, catalog, generation, validation, return, support and audit connections are visible or clearly mapped across companion diagrams.

issues.baseline: Retrieved context <=8000 tokens is not a complete input budget. Temperature is only identified explicitly in notes.
issues.minimal_fix: Give total input budget and allocations, output reserve, context-capacity check and explicit temperature not sent/default setting.
issues.acceptance: The figures reconcile, proposed values are labeled, overflow/truncation failure behavior is safe, and no unsupported sampling parameter is claimed supported.

issues.baseline: The concise AI-assisted wording understates substantive generated reasoning, architecture and code.

issues.acceptance: The final submission attestation can be made truthfully. A generic approval or AI disclosure alone is insufficient.
